content.question: What is transfer learning?
options: Training a model from scratch on a brand-new task with a large labeled dataset.
Applying the knowledge gained from training a model on one task to a different but related task.
Combining several independently trained models into a single ensemble.
Automatically generating labeled data for tasks where labels are missing.
content.answer: Applying the knowledge gained from training a model on one task to a different but related task.
